subject: general
question: Which of the following events.is known as the Calcutta killings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Direct Action Day.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Ali Jinnah**__ named __**August 16th, 1946**__ as **__Direct Action Day__** and asked **__Muslims__** nationwide to **__stop all commercial activities__**.
 
• This was done to __**exert pressure**__ on the **__British government__** to **__accede__** the **__demand__** of__** establishment of a Pakistan**__ dominated by Muslims.
 
• __**‘Direct Action Day’**__ led to the start of __**multiple violent incidents**__ that took place for a few days known as the **__Week of the long Knives.__**
 
• He wanted Muslims to stop all commerce and trade but his call **__unintentionally sparked__** the **__greatest racial rioting__** of the **__20th century.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​The goal of the **3-person cabinet mission sent by Clement Atlee in 1946__** was to finalize plans for the**__ handover of power__** from the British Raj to the Indian leadership.
 
• The Mission discussed initial proposals for the structure of the future Dominion of India and its government with leaders of the Indian National Congress and the **__All India Muslim League.__**
 
• Under pressure from Jinnah’s Muslim League, the Mission proposed __**an alternative plan**__ to divide India into **__Hindu-majority India__** and **__Muslim-majority Pakistan.__**
 
• Jinnah decided to__** boycott**__ the Constituent Assembly to **__apply pressure on Congress and the British__** because he feared **__Hindu dominance in the assembly post independence.__**
